meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个对立视角互相挑刺,把粗糙想法磨成可执行的严谨计划。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果重要决策前想先把方案漏洞和过度设计吵一遍。
copy.tagline_en: Debate a plan across five rival agents, then distill what actually holds up.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your plan's weak spots attacked before you commit.

howto.what: 加载后它会说 “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,自任 Lead 拉起 5 名互相攻击的类别成员交叉批判,只留站得住脚的结论,再强制交给 plan agent 写成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说 “hyperplan”、“hpp” 等关键词,或规划需要暴露薄弱假设、盲点与过度设计时触发;要求已启用 team-mode。

howto.what_en: On load it says “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”, acts as Lead of 5 hostile category members who cross-critique, keeps only defensible insights, then mandatorily hands them to the `plan` agent for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “hyperplan”, “hpp” etc., or when a plan needs weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering surfaced. Requires team-mode enabled.

say_en.text: hpp: cut this refactor to the minimum that ships
